noteA.text: A · Design-first. Swipe the shelf; the centre card is the active design and fills the stage. Edit / Duplicate / Rename / Delete under the name. Tap a card to try it.

noteB.text: B · Inventory-first. A bag button opens a sheet: Designs / Sets tabs, search, material filters, grid of tiles, import/export. Scales to big bags; one step further from the dice.

noteBS.text: B+ · Bag sets: sets that belong to the bag, no character (Standard 7, Advantage, Fireball...). Characters sit below with their own sets. Big row = open on the roll mat, ready to roll. Lightning = quick roll in place.

noteC.text: C · A character: own sets plus rolls generated from the sheet (skills, saves, attacks). Big row opens the roll mat with the dice set out (last roll's faces); Roll or flick. Lightning = quick roll without leaving.

controls.text:
Which of today's controls go where

Editor (per design, unchanged): Randomize + undo/redo, Substrate, Colors, Stone, Epoxy, Numbers, Relief & patina, Filigree.

Move out of the design:
· Shape + Custom set → the set (a design no longer owns a shape)
· Save / Load design → Save / Load bag, plus 'Export this design'

Stay app-wide (not saved per design): Showcase settings, Roll feel & sound, PNG/JPG export, Settings/Reset.

rec.text:
Hierarchy: Bag → designs + bag sets + characters → character sets + sheet rolls.

Every set path leads INTO the 3D roll mat; quick roll is the shortcut, not the default.
